items.stem:
(a) Write a program to remove all duplicate elements from a list, keeping the first occurrence of each. (2)
(b) Write a program to input a list of numbers and display the largest and smallest numbers without using max() and min(). (3)
items.answer:
(a)
L = eval(input("Enter a list: "))
U = []
for x in L:
    if x not in U:
        U.append(x)
print(U)
# Sample run: input [3, 5, 3, 7, 5, 9] → output: [3, 5, 7, 9]
(b)
L = eval(input("Enter a list: "))
big = small = L[0]
for x in L:
    if x > big:
        big = x
    if x < small:
        small = x
print("Largest:", big, "Smallest:", small)
# Sample run: input [12, 45, 7, 30] → output: Largest: 45 Smallest: 7
items.markingKey: 5 marks: (a) input 1, logic and output 1; (b) input 1, loop/condition 1, output 1.
